exposure: intrapartum CD after the onset of labor
cohort: Women with two consecutive singleton deliveries, nulliparous and delivered at term at the time of first delivery
finding: Antepartum cesarean delivery was associated with a two-fold increased risk of placenta previa, placenta accreta/increta, and significant postpartum hemorrhage in the second delivery compared to women with a prior vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Antepartum cesarean delivery was associated with a two-fold increased risk of placenta previa, placenta accreta/increta, and significant postpartum hemorrhage in the second delivery compared to women with a prior vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Term at the time of first delivery
